What is the purpose of the HTML <header>: To define a container for introductory content or a set of navigation links.
What is the use of a DNS Server?: Converts a domain name to an IP Address
What is the OSI Model?: OSI is a reference system that lays out how computers communicate with each other over a network.
What is PRAM?: A battery powered RAM for older Mac computers that holds important information for your system
What is a Solid State Drive?: A type of storage device that uses flash memory to store and access data
What is a Ping?: The process of sending signals to other devices and waiting for a response
What does DNS do?: Maps domain names to IP addresses
What is a Subnet?: A smaller network that is nested inside a large network.
What is a username?: A unique name for a user on a website
